for sure
this time!

text_block_list.text: Hnngh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Leave me alone! Just go away!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It seems my attempt at encouragement
has the
reverse effect on Нарита Таисин's
mood, and she
kicks me out without a
second thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I realize that telling her to calm down
without
considering her feelings might
have been rather
insensitive—so I wait
for her, intending to
apologize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
I wanted to apologize for what I said in the
waiting room.

text_block_list.text:
You've been standing here this whole
time just for
that?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh. I don't even know what to say.
You're so...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Never mind. Anyway, now that I've
calmed down
a bit...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You were right. I was able to see what
was wrong.
I still have a long ways to go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure. What are we still standing
here and
talking for, then?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Let's go to your office and figure out
how to get
me first place!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Shut up! I'm not sad!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm just mad at myself for being so
pathetic!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What are you on about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You're gonna put this off till tomorrow?
We
should be starting right now!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You want me to train hard-core? Bring it
on. I'll
get super strong and grab first
place next time!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She grins fiercely, eyes blazing, and I
recognize it
as the flames of her
determination to win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She vows to make a comeback, and we
begin our
days of hard-core training.
